statement: Run 110 shows deposition-1 and furnace-1 in one compact cleanroom cell joined by a direct four-cell ground belt. The line delivered all 12 dielectric-stack lots at 1.3% utilization with zero blocked item-ticks, endpoint-capacity loss, endpoint-power loss, or endpoint failure. Furnace utilization is 30.0% with 168.0 seconds of raw input wait; deposition utilization is 32.1% with 163.0 seconds of its own input wait and no blocked, unpowered, failed, or utility-wait time. Exact eligible furnace starvation is 38,856 ticks, led by 22,733 ticks while deposition is processing and 6,223 while deposition is waiting for input; the remaining states are material already in the 900 ms loader-line-unloader path. The installed deposition controller already observes nine coverage-deficit episodes totaling 204.5 seconds, activates agile-pulse-fast three times, and runs nine normal plus three recovery jobs. This evidence rules out local belt capacity, duplicate furnace capacity, power, and failure as the present cause; the remaining signal is upstream cadence and phase alignment under the already commissioned recovery envelope.
